resistant-ai.note: AI defences against document forgery and financial fraud (Prague; a Delaware parent files the Form D); Index led the $2.75M seed of January 2021, which its list marks, then joined the $16.6M Series A led by GV that October (the firm's post; the Form D of June 2021 carrying Jan Hammer is that round, which the band read as the entry); $25M Series B in October 2025

revenuecat.note: In-app subscription infrastructure for mobile apps (San Francisco); 'we're leading RevenueCat's $15M Series A' (the firm's post by Mark Fiorentino, 2020-08-11); $50M Series C in June 2025

revolut.note: Global financial app (London); Index entered in the Series A of July 2016 led by Balderton (the firm's post of 2016-07-11 lists 'Revolut's institutional investors (including Balderton Capital, Ribbit Capital, Index Ventures, Point Nine ...)') and led the $66M Series B of July 2017 ('The investment round was led by Index Ventures'), Martin Mignot on the board; $115B in July 2026 (aligned to a16z's cited mark). The firm's list marks it 'backed at Seed'; the record names the entry a Series A (D8 score)

robinhood.note: Commission-free brokerage (Menlo Park; Nasdaq: HOOD, IPO July 2021); 'as Robinhood announces its Series A, where we had strong enough conviction to double-down on our seed investment to lead the $13M round' (the firm's post by Jan Hammer, 2014-09-23; the $3M seed of December 2013); the band read the 2019 filing; market cap aligned to a16z's cited figure

roblox.note: User-generated games platform (San Mateo; NYSE: RBLX, direct listing March 2021); 'we have co-led a $92m investment in Roblox' with Meritech, 'the first equity financing in over five years' (the firm's posts, 2017-03-14), Neil Rimer on the board; market cap aligned to a16z's cited figure

rohlik.note: Online grocery delivery in central Europe (Prague); Index entered in the EUR 190M Series C of March 2021 led by Partech (the firm's post), Jan Hammer and Sofia Dolfe; the EUR 100M round of July 2021 valued it at EUR 1B ($1.2B), the last priced mark, stale beyond 24 months
